groups.saying_opens: وقت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قرنا لأهل

notes: Two sayings with their own isnad (rule 4a): the first (the Najd, Shām and Madina miqāts) is Ibn Umar's own report; the second (Yalamlam for Yemen) comes after «وبلغني أن النبي ...».
«بلغني» is a gap with no named transmitter, so it is an unnamed link (rule 8).
The remark «وذكر العراق فقال لم يكن عراق يومئذ» is Ibn Umar's comment, not a route.
